summary: A web application for students to discover campus events and register.

acceptance_criteria: Display event title, date, venue, and description.
Events are sorted by date ascending.
Students can filter events by category.

requirements.description: Students can register for an event.
acceptance_criteria: A student can register for an available event.
A confirmation is shown after successful registration.

requirements.description: Organizers can create and manage events.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized organizers can create and update events.
Organizers can view registration lists for their events.
